public_status: Unconfirmed candidate signal, ready for expert review
novelty_note: No match in the NASA Exoplanet Archive confirmed-planet, TOI, KOI and Kepler DR24/DR25 TCE tables within 65 arcsec. The community follow-up archive returned HTTP 503 and the literature was not searched on 2026-10-22, so novelty is not established.
ephemeris_note: Frozen search value, no refit and no uncertainty; do not use for predicted transit times.
duration_note: Search-grid value (0.195 d), not a fit.
radius_conditions: Only if KIC 10528996 is the host and the dip is undiluted (Gaia DR3 Teff 5669 K, R* 1.14-1.17 R_sun).
radius_worst_case_conditions: Worst-case dilution by the modelled neighbours.
host_test: The difference-image test assigned the target in 9 of 11 fitted quarters (Q1 untested); the stricter gate passes 4/12. The per-star brightness test target z 18.4. Injection controls recovered 11/11 fitted quarters (synthetic pixel response only).
limitations: An eclipsing binary within ~1-2 arcsec or below the Gaia limit is not excluded.
A G 18.8 source at 21.6 arcsec lies outside the pixel model; Q1 is untested.
open_questions: AO/speckle imaging 0.1-2 arcsec to dmag ~7.4; a spectrum for stellar density; check the community follow-up archive and the literature.
